verdict.rationale: Aleph's trial page says users can "cancel and remove your data at any time," which is a first-party deletion claim, but it is a single marketing line with no documented mechanism. Encryption and access-permission claims are adjacent controls and do not count toward retention or deletion. missing for 10: configurable retention periods/policies, documented deletion workflow (self-serve or via request) and its scope (connected source data, AI agent conversation context, backups), deletion timelines/guarantees, controls over AI/LLM data retention, independent corroboration.
